result_text:
I fixed the four broken path patterns in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's `*Scoping*` tests pass, but I didn't add tests for the new cases (`.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`).

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pattern read `(html|html|xhtml)`; it is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules all use it, so they now cover `.htm` and still cover `.html` and `.xhtml`.
- **.NET assembly doc XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript "// Generated by":** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes, because the generated rules also check file content.
